content.value: A 0.6 m thick furnace wall $[ k = 2 \mathrm { \ W / ( m ^ { \circ } C ) } ]$ is to be insulated with a material $[ k =$ 0.05 $\mathrm { W } / ( \mathrm { m } ^ { 0 } \mathrm { C } ) ]$ . The temperature inside the furnace is $1 1 0 0 ^ { 0 } \mathrm { C } .$ If the heat loss should not exceed 500 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ for the outer surface temperature of $6 0 ^ { 0 } \mathrm { C } ,$ what thickness of insulation is required?
